upgrade.log:
PostgreSQL 16 -> 18 (windows), Kazma's database on port 5432:
   1. Create the WAL archive folder
      cmd /c if not exist C:\ProgramData\Kazma\pg_wal_archive-18 mkdir C:\ProgramData\Kazma\pg_wal_archive-18
   2.   (continued)
      icacls C:\ProgramData\Kazma\pg_wal_archive-18 /inheritance:r /grant *S-1-5-20:(OI)(CI)M /grant KazmaDrill_1:(OI)(CI)M /grant *S-1-5-32-544:(OI)(CI)F
   3. Install PostgreSQL 18 (a Windows service)
      winget install --id PostgreSQL.PostgreSQL.18 --exact --silent --override "... --servicename postgresql-x64-18 --serverport 55432 --superpassword ****"
   4. Start it at boot
      sc config postgresql-x64-18 start= auto
   5. Restart it when it fails
      sc failure postgresql-x64-18 reset= 86400 actions= restart/5000/restart/30000/restart/60000
   6. Wait for it to answer
      wait
   7. Set the superuser's password, this machine only, Kazma's database
      C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\psql.exe -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X -q -p 55432 -d postgres < (password, settings)
   8. Restart it to apply the settings
      restart
   9. Wait for it to answer
      wait
  10. Create the kazma_app role (not a superuser)
      C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\psql.exe -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X -q -p 55432 -d kazma < kazma_app_role.sql
  11. Give kazma_app its password
      C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\psql.exe -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X -q -p 55432 -d kazma < (password)
  then: once no chat turn runs, stop Kazma through its guard and hold it
  then: copy Kazma's database from PostgreSQL 16 into 18 (port 55432) and compare every table and sequence
  then: PostgreSQL 18 on port 5432
  then: Stop PostgreSQL 18 (it moves to port 5432)
  then: Stop PostgreSQL 16 (Kazma's database until now)
  then: PostgreSQL 16 no longer starts at boot (kept: the way back)
  then: Start PostgreSQL 18 on port 5432
  then: start Kazma and see it signed in to PostgreSQL 18. .env does not change.
